Surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Nava Therapeutics
providers.description: Nava Therapeutics is a life-sciences company developing lipid nanoparticle (LNP) technology for delivering RNA therapeutics precisely to specific organs and cells, aiming to extend genetic medicines to previously untreatable diseases. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network, Nava operates in the therapeutics / RNA-delivery sector and, as a private clinical-stage biotech, publishes a corporate marketing site (pipeline, team, newsroom) but no public developer, API, or integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Octant
providers.description: Octant is a precision medicine company developing next-generation small molecule therapeutics by merging biology, chemistry, and computation to engineer drugs that target complex cellular mechanisms. Its programs span protein misfolding and mistrafficking diseases, oncology, metabolism, and immunology, with lead candidate OCT-980 — a first-in-disease oral small molecule designed to correct protein misfolding for rhodopsin gene mutations in autosomal dominant retinitis pigmentosa. Octant is a portfolio company of 8vc. It publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Relation Rx
providers.description: Relation Therapeutics (Relation Rx) is a London- and Boston-based end-to-end biotechnology company developing transformational medicines with technology at its core. The company combines single-cell multi-omics analysis of patient tissue, functional genomics and disease-relevant assays, and machine learning to decode disease biology, identify and validate therapeutic targets, and advance its own pipeline of drug candidates. Relation is a DCVC portfolio company and has announced research collaborations with partners including Novartis. It operates as a therapeutics developer rather than a software or API provider, and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: SpyBiotech
providers.description: SpyBiotech is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation vaccines against infectious diseases and cancer using its proprietary SpyTag/SpyCatcher "protein superglue" platform. The technology snaps target antigens onto virus-like particles (VLPs) to produce highly immunogenic vaccines with greater ease and speed. An Oxford University spinout backed by GV, its pipeline includes candidates such as SpyVLP01 targeting human cytomegalovirus (hCMV). This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; SpyBiotech publishes a corporate marketing website but no public developer or product API surface.

providers.name: Trial Library
providers.description: Trial Library is an AI-native oncology clinical trials technology company that integrates clinical trials into routine cancer care. Its provider-facing decision-support platform helps community oncology practices and health systems identify eligible patients and match them to open trials at the point of care, while a navigation layer supports patients through enrollment and completion by proactively addressing transportation, food, language, and scheduling barriers. Trial Library works across health systems, biopharma sponsors, and research sites to expand equitable access to cancer clinical trials. The company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of lux-capital.

providers.name: Umoja Biopharma
providers.description: Umoja Biopharma is a Seattle-based clinical-stage immuno-oncology company developing in vivo CAR T cell therapies for cancer. Its VivoVec lentiviral platform generates CAR T cells directly in a patient's body, removing the ex vivo manufacturing step of traditional cell therapy, and the company operates its own manufacturing facility in Louisville, Colorado. Its pipeline includes UB-VV111 (CD19), UB-VV400 (the industry's first known CD22-directed in vivo CAR T candidate, FDA IND clearance July 2026), and UB-VV500. Umoja is backed by investors including DCVC (DCVC Bio) and SoftBank Vision Fund 2. The company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: XellSmart Biomedical
providers.description: XellSmart Biomedical (士泽生物医药) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Suzhou and Shanghai, China, founded in 2021 by Dr. Xiang Li. The company develops clinical-grade, allogeneic, off-the-shelf iPSC-derived cell therapies for central nervous system diseases, with NMPA- and U.S. FDA-cleared registrational clinical trials in Parkinson's disease, spinal cord injury, and ALS. XellSmart is a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company and publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Bindbridge
providers.description: Bindbridge is an AI-driven molecular discovery company founded in 2025 and based in Cambridge, UK, developing next-generation crop protection through targeted protein degradation. Its BRIDGE platform uses AI to discover and design molecular glues and targeted protein degraders with novel modes of action against weeds and crop diseases, combining AI candidate generation, computational docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and free-energy binding calculations to accelerate agricultural R&D across herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides. The company raised $3.8M to help reduce billion-dollar crop losses and is backed by Speedinvest. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; it publishes no public API or developer surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Color Health
providers.description: Color Health (founded as Color Genomics in 2015) is a population health technology company that operates a nationwide, oncologist-led Virtual Cancer Clinic and delivers population-scale precision health programs - hereditary cancer and cardiovascular genetic testing, pharmacogenomics, cancer early detection and screening, and clinical care management - for employers, unions, health plans, governments, and public health institutions. Color does NOT publish a public, self-service developer API. Access to its platform is enterprise/partner-gated and contracted directly with organizations; data exchange with health systems and EHRs is handled through interoperability partners (e.g. Redox) using FHIR/HL7 rather than an open developer portal. The APIs listed here are logical, honestly-modeled surfaces (endpointsModeled) that describe how such a program is typically integrated - they are not confirmed public endpoints.

providers.name: Aqtual
providers.description: Aqtual, Inc. is a Hayward, California precision-medicine company founded in 2019 by Diana Abdueva (Founder and CEO) and co-founder Rich Rava, developing blood-based diagnostics on a proprietary "active chromatin" cell-free DNA (cfDNA) platform. Rather than reading cfDNA for mutations alone, Aqtual captures the previously unexplored cfDNA fragments bound to active chromatin, so a single routine blood draw reports on DNA, epigenetic regulation and protein-DNA binding together — surveying on the order of 200,000 gene promoters, 400,000 enhancers, 50,000 insulators, 20,000 silencers and a million transcription-factor binding sites. Its lead product is a therapy-response prediction test for rheumatoid arthritis, evaluated in the prospective PRIMA-102 observational trial (NCT05936970), with oncology programs in leiomyosarcoma immunotherapy response and early colorectal cancer detection, and stated expansion into immunology, cardiovascular, metabolic and neurological disease. The company raised a USD 16 million Series A in October 2023 and over USD 31 million in Series B funding announced July 2025 from Bold Capital, the Bold Longevity Growth Fund, Genoa Ventures, Manta Ray Ventures and Yu Galaxy. Aqtual is a clinical-diagnostics and life-sciences business, not a software vendor: as of August 2026 it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract of any kind, and every /.well-known/ and contract-discovery path on aqtual.com returns 404.

providers.name: BiVACOR
providers.description: BiVACOR, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage medical device company with corporate operations in Huntington Beach, California, clinical operations in Houston, Texas, and engineering operations on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia. It develops the BiVACOR Total Artificial Heart (TAH), a titanium biventricular rotary blood pump built around a single magnetically levitated rotor with a dual-sided impeller that replaces both ventricles of a failing heart, with no valves, flexing diaphragms or mechanical bearings, and flows above 12 L/min. Founded by Chief Technical Officer Daniel Timms, PhD, and led by CEO Jim Dillon with Chief Medical Officer William E. Cohn, MD, the company completed the first-in-human implantation at The Texas Heart Institute in July 2024 under an FDA Early Feasibility Study, received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in May 2025, and was accepted into the FDA Total Product Life Cycle Advisory Program in August 2025. The TAH is an investigational device, limited by federal law to investigational use, and is not approved for commercial sale. BiVACOR is a medical hardware and clinical-research business - it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Conception
providers.description: Conception is a Berkeley, California biotechnology company founded in 2018 by CEO Matt Krisiloff (previously a director of Y Combinator Research and an early OpenAI team member) and originally operated under the name Ovid Research. It is building in-vitro gametogenesis (IVG) as a clinical therapy: taking a patient blood draw, reprogramming the blood cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, and then guiding those cells through primordial germ cell, oogonia and follicle stages inside engineered three-dimensional ovarian organoids until they mature into viable human eggs. Its laboratory stack combines single-cell gene-expression mapping, 3D tissue engineering, high-throughput screening and computer-vision quality control, and in an announcement published 2026-08-07 the company reported generating the first fully stem-cell-derived human ovarian follicles containing early oocytes progressing through meiosis. Conception has raised roughly USD 38 million from investors including Age 1, Calm Ventures, SciFounders, Gaingels, Maiora Ventures and PEAK6 Strategic Capital. It is a wet-lab therapeutic research company rather than a software vendor: its entire public web presence is a two-page Framer marketing site with a science-updates post and an Ashby-hosted job board, and it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDKs and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Helix
providers.description: Helix is a population genomics company operating an end-to-end precision health platform - a proprietary Exome+ next-generation sequencing assay, a CLIA/CAP-certified clinical lab, and bioinformatics tooling - that enables health systems, life sciences companies, and payers to integrate genomic data into clinical care and research at population scale. Through its DNA Product Studio, Helix exposes a partner-gated developer surface - a Genomics API (direct programmatic access to 100M+ base pairs including SNPs, indels, and copy number variants with panel-grade coverage of actionable genes), an Ancestry API (continental ancestry for 6 global populations or regional ancestry for 26+ populations), and an Insight API (user-specific results for hundreds of traits and conditions, from single-marker traits to machine-learning polygenic risk scores) - alongside Embedded Apps and an App Acceleration Framework for building white-label DNA products. API access is enterprise/partner-gated and provisioned through Helix partnerships; there is no public self-serve developer portal or openly published API specification, so the API surface below is modeled from Helix's public product documentation.

providers.name: Bland Company
providers.description: The Bland Company is a London-based food-technology and biotechnology startup building functional plant proteins that replace eggs in food manufacturing. Its feedstock-agnostic process upcycles underused agricultural side streams into flavor-neutral, cost-stable proteins engineered to match animal-protein functionality — solubility, foaming, gelling, and emulsifying — for bakery, sauces, beverages, and snacks. The company raised a ~$2.7M pre-seed round led by Initialized Capital. It publishes no public developer API surface (no docs, SDKs, or GitHub); this profile is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio lead.

providers.name: Spark Therapeutics
providers.description: Spark Therapeutics is a Philadelphia-based gene therapy company founded in 2013 with roots at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP). Spark developed Luxturna (voretigene neparvovec-rzyl), the first FDA-approved gene therapy for a genetic disease in the United States, approved in December 2017 for the treatment of inherited retinal disease caused by biallelic RPE65 mutations. Roche acquired Spark Therapeutics in December 2019 for approximately $4.3 billion, and Spark has since been integrated into the Roche Group, operating as a Genentech subsidiary. The original sparktx.com domain now redirects to gene.com/spark. Spark does not publish any public developer APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or GitHub organization. As a pharmaceutical/biotech operating under Roche, Spark's public technical surface is limited to patient and prescriber information for Luxturna and adverse event reporting channels (FDA MedWatch and 1-855-SPARKTX).

providers.name: Twig
providers.description: Twig (twig.bio) is a UK biotechnology company using artificial intelligence and machine learning to design sustainable bioengineered ingredients — "AI defined ingredients that don't cost the earth." Its proprietary twig:tech platform pairs bio:drive, an AI/ML design engine that generates and scores novel microbe designs across pathway and enzyme selection, gene edits, and expression levels, with grow:bot, an automated high-throughput lab that builds and tests those designs and feeds every result back into the next design cycle. Twig aims to cultivate clean ingredients from bacteria via fermentation rather than extracting them from the ground or sea or producing them with fossil fuels. Twig is a Seedcamp portfolio company and is backed by additional early-stage investors. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio lead; Twig currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface — its api./app. subdomains resolve to internal infrastructure — so this pass captures company identity and a domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Windfall Bio
providers.description: Windfall Bio transforms methane emissions into organic fertilizer and carbon credits using proprietary non-GMO methane-eating microbes (methanotrophs). The company operates across agriculture, coal mining, oil & gas, and waste management, capturing methane at the source and converting it into a soil amendment while generating verifiable carbon credits. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the latest enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Abpro
providers.description: Abpro Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in the Boston area (Woburn / Burlington, Massachusetts) that develops next-generation multispecific antibody therapeutics for oncology and ophthalmology. Its DiversImmune antibody-discovery platform and MultiMab multispecific-engineering platform are used to build bispecific and tetravalent T-cell-engager constructs, led by ABP-102/CT-P72, a tetravalent bispecific HER2 x CD3 T-cell engager partnered with Celltrion, alongside the ABP-110, ABP-150 and ABP-201 programs. Abpro is a drug developer rather than a software company: its public web surface is a corporate and investor-relations site, and it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, webhook surface, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: AI Medical Service
providers.description: AI Medical Service Inc. (AIM) is a Tokyo-based med-tech company founded in September 2017 with the mission to save lives worldwide by eliminating gastrointestinal cancers through earlier detection. AIM develops endoscopic AI (artificial intelligence) that assists physicians in real-time diagnostic imaging of the digestive tract, drawing on joint research with more than 100 medical institutions. Its flagship gastroAI family of endoscopic image diagnosis support software has secured regulatory approval in Japan, Singapore, and Thailand, and an earlier FDA approval in the United States. The company distributes its AI on-premise today and is building an in-house cloud platform to broaden access; it currently publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a health-tech lead backed by SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Alumis
providers.description: Alumis Inc. (NASDAQ: ALMS) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered at 280 East Grand Avenue, South San Francisco, California, developing oral therapies for immune-mediated diseases. Incorporated in 2021 as Esker Therapeutics and renamed Alumis in January 2022, its pipeline is led by envudeucitinib, an oral allosteric TYK2 inhibitor in Phase 3 for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis and systemic lupus erythematosus; A-005, a CNS-penetrant TYK2 inhibitor for neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative disease; and lonigutamab, a subcutaneously delivered anti-IGF-1R antibody for thyroid eye disease. Alumis describes a proprietary precision data-analytics platform that integrates genetic, genomic, proteomic, biological and clinical insight, but it is an internal therapeutic-development capability and is not exposed publicly. The company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Apreohealth
providers.description: Apreo Health is a clinical-stage medical device company based in Menlo Park, California, developing a novel, tissue-sparing bronchoscopic treatment for severe emphysema. Its investigational Apreo BREATHE Airway Scaffold uses a self-expanding nitinol scaffold to tent open targeted airways, releasing trapped air and reducing lung hyperinflation without removing healthy tissue. The device received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2024 and is being evaluated in the BREATHE clinical trial program. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, F-Prime Capital, and OSF Ventures, Apreo Health is a physical medical device company with no public developer API, SDK, or software platform; this profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bioyond Robotics
providers.description: Bioyond Robotics (奔曜科技) is a life-sciences intelligent-automation company founded in 2021 and headquartered in Shanghai's Zhangjiang Science City. It combines robotics, machine vision, and artificial intelligence to build autonomous laboratory solutions for scientific research, drug discovery, applied chemistry, synthetic biology, multiomics, and clinical diagnostics. Its product line spans the LabGenius robot platform (liquid-handling and transport robots), the LabMate automation platform (material/liquid handling, stackers, and intelligent scheduling), the LabMind laboratory software platform for integrating external instruments and modules, and the BIOYOND AutoSeq genetic-analysis system. Bioyond is backed by Qiming Venture Partners. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — this record captures its identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Cellinobio
providers.description: Cellino Bio develops AI-driven optical bioprocessing technology for personalized regenerative medicine. Its proprietary Nebula platform combines deep learning, laser-based cell management, and closed-loop optical bioprocesses to manufacture patient-specific, induced-pluripotent-stem-cell-derived cell and tissue replacements at scale. The company targets degenerative and chronic conditions including kidney disease, lung disease, spinal cord injury, Alzheimer's, and diabetes. Cellino is a life-sciences/biotech company with no public developer API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence and is backed by Felicis and Khosla Ventures.

providers.name: Complete Omics
providers.description: Complete Omics is a Baltimore, Maryland based, CLIA- and CAP-accredited molecular diagnostics company building ultra-deep, clinically reproducible proteomics and multi-omics testing. Its Complete360 liquid- and tissue-biopsy platform and Valid-NEO companion-diagnostics platform apply AI-assisted analysis of high-dimensional biological data across oncology, neurology, cardiovascular, and immunology testing. The company holds 40+ global patents and 20+ top-tier journal publications. Complete Omics is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface exists at this time; this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Eikon Therapeutics
providers.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company (Nasdaq: EIKN) founded in 2019 and headquartered in Millbrae, California, with additional offices in New York and Jersey City. Eikon built a proprietary drug-discovery platform around single-molecule live-cell imaging, applying super-resolution fluorescence microscopy and high-throughput single-molecule tracking to observe how proteins and drug targets move and interact inside living cells in real time. The technology descends from co-founder Eric Betzig's Nobel Prize-winning work in super-resolution microscopy, and the company is led by former Merck R&D chief Roger Perlmutter. Eikon uses these measurements to discover and develop novel therapeutics across oncology and other disease areas. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lux Capital and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Eikon publishes a corporate and investor web presence but no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Luminate
providers.description: Luminate Medical is a healthcare company delivering cancer care at home. Its Lotus Home Infusion platform enables nurse-led, at-home chemotherapy infusion, partnering with oncology clinics, health plans, and patients while keeping drug dispensing oversight with the originating cancer center. Luminate is a portfolio company of 8vc and GV. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer, API, documentation, or integration surface.

providers.name: Mana.bio
providers.description: Mana.bio is an AI-driven drug-delivery biotechnology company specializing in programmable lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) for nucleic-acid therapeutics and vaccines, including mRNA, DNA, and CRISPR-based gene therapy. The company runs a closed-loop design-build-test-learn platform that uses machine-learning models to design novel LNP candidates, synthesizes dozens of formulations weekly via high-throughput automation, screens them with comprehensive assays, and feeds results back to continuously improve its models — targeting precise, optimized extrahepatic delivery. Mana.bio also operates Mina (ChatLNP), an AI agent that helps scientists explore curated literature, predict LNP properties, and optimize formulations, plus an LNP patents / freedom-to-operate map. The company is backed by a16z. Mana.bio publishes no first-party developer or product API; its only public agent surface is a Wix Site MCP endpoint and an llms.txt on its site.

providers.name: Model Medicines
providers.description: Model Medicines is an AI-first biotechnology company based in San Diego, California, discovering and developing first-in-class small-molecule drugs by targeting fundamental disease mechanisms it calls biological choke points. Its end-to-end GALILEO AI engine spans drug design, target discovery, and preclinical development, supported by specialized models including AmesNet for regulatory-grade toxicology prediction and ChemPrint for chemical property prediction. Lead programs target RdRp Thumb-1 (a conserved allosteric pocket on viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase) and BRD4, with lead assets MDL-001, a broad-spectrum oral antiviral candidate, and MDL-4102. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Model Medicines publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface; its AI platform is used internally for drug discovery.

providers.name: Numerion Labs
providers.description: Numerion Labs is an AI-driven drug discovery company building an "AI superplatform" that explores chemical space to uncover novel, drug-like molecules using machine learning. The company pairs computational drug-hunting with its own development programs, applying generative and predictive models to surface previously unseen chemical matter and advance therapeutic candidates. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, Numerion Labs currently publishes a marketing and corporate web presence (platform overview, pipeline programs, team, news/blog, and contact) but does not expose a public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Rani Therapeutics
providers.description: Rani Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing the RaniPill, an ingestible robotic capsule engineered to deliver biologic drugs orally in place of subcutaneous or intravenous injections. The platform aims to preserve injection-comparable bioavailability while removing the pain and adherence barriers of needle-based therapies across chronic and metabolic disease areas. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network; the company is a publicly traded life-sciences firm and does not currently publish a developer API, developer portal, or programmatic data surface.

providers.name: Revolution Medicines
providers.description: Revolution Medicines is a clinical-stage precision oncology company headquartered in Redwood City, California, developing targeted therapies for RAS-addicted cancers. Its pipeline centers on RAS(ON) inhibitors — including daraxonrasib (RMC-6236), zoldonrasib (RMC-9805), and elironrasib (RMC-6291) — designed to directly target the active, GTP-bound (ON) state of oncogenic RAS proteins across mutations such as KRAS G12X. The company pairs structure-based drug discovery with clinical development to pursue treatments for pancreatic, lung, colorectal, and other RAS-driven tumors. Revolution Medicines is a publicly traded corporate entity (Nasdaq: RVMD) and does not currently expose a public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Topos Bio
providers.description: Topos Bio is an AI-native drug discovery company building all-atom foundation models for intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) — dynamic, flexible proteins implicated in diseases such as Alzheimer's and prostate cancer. Its Topos-1 foundation model generates physically realistic conformational ensembles for flexible proteins, aiming to make previously undruggable targets therapeutically viable. The company is backed by Threshold Ventures. No public API or developer platform is currently published.

providers.name: Ventus Therapeutics
providers.description: Ventus Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Waltham, Massachusetts, with research operations in Montreal, Canada. Ventus uses its proprietary, machine-learning-enabled computational chemistry and structural biology platform, ReSOLVE, together with deep protein-science expertise, to design differentiated small-molecule therapeutics targeting the innate immune system (including cGAS and NLRP3 inhibitors) for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, neurological disorders, and cancer. It was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment confirmed Ventus operates a corporate/investor website only and publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Vial
providers.description: Vial is a next-generation biotech company advancing first and best-in-class biologics to treat unmet need in Immunology and Inflammation. The company pairs AI-driven drug discovery with automated, technology-enabled clinical trials, working across target discovery (identifying high-value therapeutic targets), molecule design (generating and optimizing molecular candidates), and experimental validation (high-throughput approaches to accelerate development). Its lead pipeline program is an IL-13 x TSLP bi-specific antibody in Phase 1. Vial was originally built as a tech-enabled contract research organization (CRO) focused on reimagining clinical trials, and was backed by General Catalyst. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Vial publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Vitara
providers.description: Vitara (Vitara Biomedical) is a Philadelphia-based medical technology company developing EXTEND, an investigational neonatal support platform that surrounds extremely premature newborns in a fluid-filled, fetal-physiology-modeled environment for their first 28 days, delaying the stress of early air exposure so vital organs can continue to develop. The company aims to improve survival and reduce long-term complications for infants born as early as 22 weeks gestation. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; Vitara publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation, and its technology has not received U.S. FDA market clearance.

providers.name: Varda Space Industries
providers.description: Varda Space Industries is an American space manufacturing company founded in 2021 and headquartered in El Segundo, California. Varda designs, builds and flies the W-Series, a free-flying orbital production satellite paired with a hypersonic reentry capsule, so that materials can be processed in microgravity and returned to Earth. The company sells three lines of service: biopharmaceutical processing (small-molecule crystallization that gravity disrupts on Earth), a government hypersonic flight testbed that uses the capsule's Mach 25 reentry as a test article carrier, and general microgravity research flights. Varda is a hardware and manufacturing-services business rather than a software vendor: as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification, and customer-facing technical interfaces are documented in a downloadable Payload User Guide PDF.

providers.name: Neuralink
providers.description: Neuralink is a neurotechnology company pioneering implantable brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) intended to restore autonomy to people with unmet medical needs and, longer term, to expand human capability. Its flagship device, the N1 Implant, is a surgically embedded array of thin, flexible threads placed by a purpose-built surgical robot to record and stimulate neural activity, paired with an app that lets users control external devices. Neuralink is a frontier-tech company backed by Craft Ventures, Founders Fund, GV and Lightspeed Venture Partners. It publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its only public machine-readable surfaces are a security.txt vulnerability-disclosure record and standard web/DNS security posture. This profile was surfaced from VC portfolio data and enriched with real probed security artifacts.

providers.name: Satellite Bio
providers.description: Satellite Bio is a biotechnology company developing off-the-shelf liver cell therapies to treat severe and life-threatening liver diseases. Its tissue therapeutics platform engineers functional hepatocytes designed to engraft and restore liver function, combining the biological power of liver cells with scalable manufacturing and distribution. The company is headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Satellite Bio is a life-sciences company and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Tahoe Therapeutics
providers.description: Tahoe Therapeutics (formerly Vevo Therapeutics) is a South San Francisco digital-biology company building the "ground truth for biological superintelligence." Its Mosaic platform generates perturbative single-cell data in vivo at gigascale, and it trains AI models — including the Tahoe-x1 single-cell foundation model (up to 3 billion parameters) and the Rhaister family of perturbation-response models — on the resulting data to discover novel drug targets and predict how patient cells respond to drugs. Tahoe openly publishes datasets (including the 100-million-cell Tahoe-100M atlas) and model weights on Hugging Face, ships the tahoe-x1 Python package on PyPI, and operates Tara, an autonomous research agent. The company does not run a public REST API. Backed by Amplify Partners; raised $30M in 2025.

providers.name: 10x Science
providers.description: 10x Science is an AI-native software company building the first AI-native protein characterization platform for the life sciences, starting with drug development. A Y Combinator W26 company founded out of Nobel laureate Carolyn Bertozzi's laboratory at Stanford University, it automates peptide mapping for protein therapeutics, delivering explainable molecular insights in minutes where legacy tools and manual workflows take months. The company raised a $4.8M seed round led by Initialized Capital and is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company; it does not yet publish a public developer API.

providers.name: CAMP4 Therapeutics
providers.description: CAMP4 Therapeutics is a clinical-stage RNA-medicines biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, pioneering a new class of antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) therapeutics designed to increase targeted gene expression. Built on the company's RAP Platform (Regulatory RNA Activating Platform), which combines epigenomics, computational biology, and machine learning to map the regulatory RNA and signaling circuits controlling gene expression, CAMP4 develops first-in-class medicines for diseases caused by insufficient protein expression, with an initial focus on central nervous system and metabolic disorders such as urea cycle disorders and SYNGAP1. Founded by CEO Josh Mandel-Brehm with scientific co-founders Rick Young (Whitehead Institute/MIT) and Len Zon (Boston Children's Hospital/Harvard), CAMP4 is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). This is a corporate/therapeutics company profile in the API Evangelist network; CAMP4 publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal, so no API artifacts apply.

providers.name: Flowneuroscience
providers.description: Flow Neuroscience is a Malmo, Sweden medtech company founded in 2016 by clinical psychologist Daniel Mansson and neuroscientist Erik Rehn. It develops a medically approved, at-home transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) headset paired with a behavioral-therapy smartphone app to treat major depressive disorder without medication. Its Flow FL-100 device is CE-marked in the EU and UK and received FDA approval (PMA P230024) as the first at-home tDCS treatment for depression, with a US launch planned for September 2026. Flow is backed by Khosla Ventures and other global investors. This is a consumer and clinical medical-device company; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Myra Vision
providers.description: Myra Vision, Inc. is a clinical-stage ophthalmic medical device company headquartered in Campbell, California, and a privately held portfolio company of the Shifamed LLC medical device incubator. It develops the Calibreye Titratable Glaucoma Therapy (TGT) Surgical System, an aqueous shunt for patients with moderate to severe glaucoma whose valve-controlled outflow channels use shape-memory nitinol and can be reversibly opened or closed in-office with a transcorneal laser, letting a clinician titrate intraocular pressure after implantation rather than committing to a fixed flow at the time of surgery. The company completed first-in-human use of the Calibreye System in 2023, received FDA conditional approval of its Investigational Device Exemption in August 2025, and enrolled the first patient in its US ADAPT clinical study in January 2026. As a medical device manufacturer its product is a physical implant and a surgical procedure, not software: Myra Vision publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification, and this profile captures its corporate identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Resolyst
providers.description: Resolyst is a specialty-care platform that positions itself as the intelligence layer for AI-enabled specialty care, extending the reach of the world's leading clinicians with continuous, research-first expertise. Rather than episodic consultations, Resolyst provides ongoing multidisciplinary medical oversight for patients with chronic conditions through specialist nurses, pharmacists, dieticians, physiotherapists and psychologists, connecting patients with local and international experts, embedding clinical research into care pathways, and convening condition-specific international expert panels for second opinions and clinical pathway oversight. Backed by Seedcamp, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Abogen
providers.description: Abogen Biosciences (Suzhou Abogen Biosciences Co., Ltd. / 苏州艾博生物科技有限公司) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in January 2019 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, dedicated to developing transformative medicines through messenger RNA (mRNA) innovation. The company has built full-scale in-house capabilities spanning the entire mRNA drug development cycle - protein engineering, mRNA sequence design and synthesis, proprietary lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery, formulation, and commercial-scale manufacturing. Its product pipeline covers infectious disease prevention and cancer immunotherapy, and it has advanced an EUA mRNA product along with additional clinical-stage candidates. Abogen is a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund. Abogen is a pharmaceutical / biotechnology company and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK; this profile captures its corporate identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Alpine Bio
providers.description: Alpine Bio is a molecular-farming biotechnology company (formerly Nobell Foods and Alpine Roads), founded in 2016 and based in South San Francisco, California. It produces next-generation protein ingredients and bioactives from plants using advanced purification and molecular farming, having expressed more than 15 complex proteins including the world's first plant-derived casein, fractionated soy protein isolates, and activated iron-loaded lactoferrin. The company sells high-purity, clean-label ingredients to food and beverage formulators for applications such as protein shakes, bars, coffee creamers, iron supplements, yogurt, and clear protein sodas, and markets animal-free dairy products under the Nobell Foods brand. It is a portfolio company of a16z surfaced in the API Evangelist network; Alpine Bio publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Formo
providers.description: Formo (Formo Foods GmbH) is a Berlin-based food-technology company producing animal-free dairy through precision fermentation and microbial fermentation of koji (Aspergillus oryzae). Instead of cows, Formo engineers microorganisms to make milk proteins such as casein, which it turns into real cheese and cream cheese products now sold across Germany and Austria. Founded by Raffael Wohlgensinger and backed by EQT Ventures, the company has received a US FDA "no questions" GRAS letter for its fermentation-derived casein. Formo is a consumer food producer and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Infinimmune
providers.description: Infinimmune is a biotechnology company that discovers and engineers human-derived antibody therapeutics. Its Complete Human Sequencing and Anthrobody library-on-B-cell platform surface rare antibodies that evolution has already proven in people, and its GLIMPSE antibody language model characterizes and optimizes candidates in silico for clinical development. Its lead program, IFX-101, is an IL-22 inhibitor for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with additional pipeline programs targeting IL-13, APRIL, and IL-17F. Backed by Playground Global. Infinimmune publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications; this API Evangelist profile captures the company identity and its public web, security, and legal surface.

providers.name: Synthekine
providers.description: Synthekine is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering, developing, and commercializing the next generation of selective cytokine therapeutics. The company believes cytokine therapeutics engineered to be selective can fundamentally change the treatment paradigm for cancer and inflammatory disease. Synthekine's engineering platforms (including its surrogate/partial agonist and orthogonal cytokine-receptor approaches) are used to design cytokines and cytokine-based cell therapies with improved selectivity and tolerability. Backed by Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; Synthekine is a therapeutics developer and publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Tidal Vision
providers.description: Tidal Vision Products, Inc. is a Bellingham, Washington biotechnology and specialty-chemicals manufacturer, and the only commercial-scale US producer of chitosan — a non-toxic, non-hazmat, biodegradable industrial biopolymer upcycled from crab and shrimp shell waste. Its zero-waste Chitofining process extracts, modifies and formulates chitosan chemistries that displace PFAS, halogenated chemicals, toxic antimicrobials and persistent plastics across three business lines: Tidal Clear water and wastewater treatment, Tidal Grow AgriScience crop and soil inputs, and Tidal-Tec Biomaterial Science performance materials. The company closed an oversubscribed $140M+ Series B in 2025 and acquired Clear Water Services. It is a materials-science manufacturer and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Variant Bio
providers.description: Variant Bio is a biotechnology company developing life-saving therapies by studying the genes of people with exceptional health-related traits. Working with partner communities around the world under an ethical, benefit-sharing approach, the company pairs large-scale genomic discovery with data science to turn genetic diversity into novel drug targets across metabolic, cardiovascular and other disease areas. Surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst, Lux Capital and SoftBank Vision Fund and profiled in the API Evangelist network; Variant Bio publishes no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: Bio-Rad Laboratories
providers.description: Bio-Rad Laboratories is a global leader in developing and manufacturing a wide range of products for the life science research and clinical diagnostic markets, including instruments, reagents, consumables, software, and services. Founded in 1952, Bio-Rad serves scientists in genomics, proteomics, cell biology, quality control, and clinical diagnostics with products like real-time PCR systems, western blotting instruments, flow cytometers, and digital PCR.

providers.name: Cyrus Biotechnology
providers.description: Cyrus Biotechnology is a Seattle-based protein-design and drug-discovery company building novel biologics for serious unmet medical needs by re-engineering existing proteins with a tight loop between computational modeling and lab testing. Its flagship product, Cyrus Bench, is a cloud-based protein modeling and structure-prediction platform that packages the Rosetta software suite (alongside deep-learning tools such as AlphaFold, OpenFold, RoseTTAFold and ProteinMPNN) behind a browser-based interface for homology modeling, protein/protein and enzyme/ligand interface design, protein stabilization, protein/ligand and protein/protein docking, and X-ray molecular replacement. Cyrus Bench is delivered as a hosted web application with user documentation rather than a public developer REST API; the company is backed by Trinity Ventures.

providers.name: Bota Biosciences
providers.description: Bota Biosciences (Bota Bio, 恩和科技) is an industrial and synthetic biology company that applies AI-driven computation and laboratory automation to bio-manufacturing. Its in-house Bota Biofoundry and Cell2Cloud platforms combine computational algorithms, non-model industrial strain engineering, rapid iterative enzyme engineering and performance protein design to shorten design-build-test-learn cycles, and in March 2026 it launched SAION AI, a three-layer "Physical AI" platform (cognition, orchestration, execution) that drives laboratory hardware through a proprietary Biological Protocol Language. Bota commercializes this work as physical ingredients rather than software: Purtect bio-preservatives (nisin, natamycin, ε-poly-lysine, lysozyme), Prorylia biomimetic proteins and Re² Coffea Arabica peptides, sold through its HeliaGenesis food and nutrition brand and its YuccaElements personal care brand, with partnerships including BASF, Proya, Syensqo and Puratos. Founded in 2019 with operations in Hangzhou, China and the San Francisco Bay Area, Bota publishes no developer portal, no public API documentation, no SDKs and no machine-readable specification; its computational software is internal laboratory tooling and its SAION AI application is reachable only through a login with an administrator-managed account whitelist.

providers.name: Finless Foods
providers.description: Finless Foods is an Emeryville, California cellular-agriculture company founded in 2017 by Michael Selden and Brian Wyrwas to grow real seafood from fish cells instead of harvesting it from the ocean. Its scientists established proprietary marine cell lines and a culture-media and bioreactor process that cultivates bluefin tuna and other high-value species into three-dimensional tissue with comparable taste, texture and nutrition to wild-caught fish, and the company has also shipped a plant-based tuna alternative into foodservice while the cell-cultivated line moves toward regulatory clearance and commercial launch. Backed by SOSV/IndieBio and a USD 34 million Series B closed in March 2022, and now led by co-founder and CEO Brandon Chen with co-founder Brian Wyrwas as CSO, Finless Foods is a food-biotechnology and consumer-products business rather than a software vendor: it operates a single-page Squarespace marketing site with a Squarespace Commerce cart, publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its 2017-era GitHub organization holds one dormant static-HTML repository.

providers.name: Acesion Pharma
providers.description: Acesion Pharma is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company based in Frederiksberg, Denmark, developing novel therapies for atrial fibrillation (AF), the most common cardiac arrhythmia. The company pioneers small-molecule SK ion channel inhibition as a differentiated mechanism to treat AF safely and effectively. Its lead program AP31969 entered Phase 2 clinical trials in January 2026, building on earlier work on the cardioversion candidate AP30663. Acesion Pharma is backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners. As a pharmaceutical R&D company it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation; this profile captures its corporate identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pivot Bio
providers.description: Pivot Bio is an agricultural biotechnology company headquartered in Berkeley, California with additional operations in St. Louis, Missouri. The company engineers naturally occurring soil microbes to fix atmospheric nitrogen on crop root systems, providing a biological alternative to synthetic nitrogen fertilizer that reduces nitrous-oxide emissions, nitrate runoff, and exposure to volatile fertilizer prices. Pivot Bio's product line includes PROVEN 40 and PROVEN G3 (corn and corn silage), RETURN (wheat and small grains), CERT-N (cotton), and RETAIN (sorghum). The company also operates N-OVATOR, an outcomes-based program that pays farmers for verified emissions reductions; the program reports having paid out more than $6M to growers since 2022 and contributing to over 1,050,000 metric tons of CO2e avoided. Pivot Bio was founded by Karsten Temme (CEO) and Alvin Tamsir. Investors include Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Temasek, DCVC, Generation Investment Management, Pavilion Capital, G2 Venture Partners, Bond, and others. Pivot Bio's product is the microbe, not an API; the company operates a farmer-facing Salesforce-based portal but does not publish a public developer API or SDK.

providers.name: Regeneron
providers.description: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals is a leading biotechnology company that invents, develops, and commercializes life-transforming medicines, including EYLEA and EYLEA HD for ophthalmology, Dupixent in immunology (co-developed with Sanofi), Libtayo and Lynozyfic in oncology and hematology, and Praluent for cardiovascular disease. Regeneron does not publish a public developer API; its Regeneron Genetics Center collaborates on large-scale genomic research via the UK Biobank, DiscovEHR, and partner platforms rather than a self-hosted API.

providers.name: Sanofi
providers.description: Sanofi is a French multinational pharmaceutical and healthcare company focused on immunology, oncology, rare diseases, and vaccines, and a leading vaccines manufacturer. Sanofi does not publish a public developer API. Its GitHub organization exists but has no public repositories. The company operates patient assistance and HCP portals as well as clinical trial information services that require authenticated access.

providers.name: aardaia
providers.description: Aardaia is a Wageningen (Netherlands) agri-biotech startup that turns wild plant species into new commercial crops through accelerated domestication, combining classical plant breeding with modern genomics and AI rather than genetic modification. Its flagship is the aardaker, a nitrogen-fixing legume-tuber that yields a naturally protein-rich crop (roughly 10g protein per 100g of fresh tuber) without synthetic fertilizer. The company raised a EUR 5M seed round led by Point Nine in 2026. Aardaia does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a Point Nine portfolio lead.

providers.name: CatalYm
providers.description: CatalYm GmbH is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Planegg-Martinsried near Munich, Germany, developing next-generation cancer immunotherapies. Its lead approach neutralizes GDF-15 (Growth Differentiation Factor 15) to reverse a key immune-resistance mechanism in solid tumors, aiming to reinstate anti-tumor immune activity and overcome resistance to checkpoint-inhibitor and other cancer therapies. The company is a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. This is a biotech/pharmaceutical organization with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Samsara Eco
providers.description: Samsara Eco is an Australian climate-technology company pioneering enzymatic recycling, a process that uses engineered enzymes to break plastics and synthetic textiles down into their molecular building blocks so they can be infinitely remade into new materials with no loss of quality. Spun out of the Australian National University, the company recovers nylon and polyester from mixed and coloured textile and plastic waste and partners with global brands to build a circular materials supply chain. It is a materials-science and biotech company rather than an API provider, and has no public developer, API, or technical integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Arthrosi Therapeutics
providers.description: Arthrosi Therapeutics, Inc. is a late-stage clinical biotechnology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in San Diego, California, by a team of gout specialists who previously led first-generation urate-transporter development at Ardea Biosciences. Its lead candidate, pozdeutinurad (AR882), is a once-daily oral next-generation URAT1 inhibitor in two fully enrolled replicate global Phase 3 trials (REDUCE 1 and REDUCE 2) for progressive and tophaceous gout, backed by roughly $299M in venture financing including a $153M Series E led by Prime Eight Capital. Sobi (Swedish Orphan Biovitrum) completed its acquisition of Arthrosi on 9 February 2026. Arthrosi is a drug developer, not a software company: it operates a WordPress corporate site with company, leadership and news pages, and publishes no developer portal, public API, SDK, package or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: BioConsortia
providers.description: BioConsortia, Inc. is an agricultural biotechnology company headquartered in Davis, California, with additional laboratories in New Zealand, that discovers and commercializes microbial biologicals for row crops and specialty agriculture. Its patented Advanced Microbial Selection (AMS) process, RhizoViz microbe-visualization tool and GenePro genomics and gene-engineering platform are used to screen a collection of more than 60,000 characterized microorganisms — including roughly 9,000 endophytes — into nitrogen-fixation biofertilizers, biocontrol products (bionematicides and biofungicides) and biostimulants, largely delivered as seed treatments. The company sells physical crop inputs through partners such as Mosaic, Nichino America and Envu; its platform technologies are internal R&D instruments rather than commercial software, and BioConsortia publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Enzymit
providers.description: Enzymit is a synthetic biology company based in Rehovot, Israel that designs novel enzymes and enables cell-free biomanufacturing. Its proprietary platform combines computational protein design, deep learning, and high-throughput testing to develop enzymes for biochemicals, food and beverage, personal care, and health and nutrition markets, with applications spanning hyaluronic acid production, cultivated-meat ingredients, and biosensors. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Enzymit publishes open research tools such as SolvIT (protein solubility prediction) and the StabilizeIT platform, but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Peptone
providers.description: Peptone is a computational drug-discovery biotech building a Product Engine that targets intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs). It couples experimental measurement of disordered proteins in solution with enhanced-sampling simulation and generative machine-learning models to resolve transient, druggable pockets and design small-molecule drug candidates against them. Peptone describes its stack as an end-to-end Protein Engineering Operating System (PeOS); its open-source research tooling (protein-disorder prediction, ensemble generators, protein language models) is published on GitHub. Peptone is a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Retro Biosciences
providers.description: Retro Biosciences is a Redwood City, California longevity biotechnology company founded in 2021 whose stated mission is to add ten years to healthy human lifespan. Its published preclinical pipeline spans RTR242, a small-molecule autophagy-flux booster aimed at Alzheimer's disease; RTR888, iPSC-derived microglial progenitors for CNS conditions; RTR890, iPSC-derived hematopoietic stem cells for blood disorders; AAV-delivered in vivo tissue reprogramming for osteoarthritis and age-related hearing loss; and AI-designed protein therapeutics, the last built on a 2025 collaboration with OpenAI on a protein-engineering model for reprogramming factors. Retro was seeded with $180M from Sam Altman and reported a $1.8B valuation in 2026. It is a therapeutics company rather than a software company: it operates a public GitHub organization of internal lab-automation and bioinformatics tooling, but publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Avistone
providers.description: Beijing Avistone Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is a commercial-stage innovative biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Beijing, China, focused on the research, development, and commercialization of first-in-class and best-in-class oncology therapies. Founded in 2012 (originally Beijing Pearl Biotechnology) and renamed Avistone in 2018, the company has two approved cancer drugs on the market: Vebreltinib (万比锐®), a MET inhibitor approved for non-small cell lung cancer and glioma indications and included in China's National Reimbursement Drug List, and Andamertinib (安比锐®), an EGFR exon 20 insertion inhibitor approved in 2026 for advanced NSCLC. Avistone maintains a pipeline of additional candidates (ANS01 through ANS09) across solid-tumor indications and is backed by IDG Capital. The company publishes no public developer API or programmatic surface; this profile captures its corporate and investor identity.

providers.name: Chroma Medicine
providers.description: Chroma Medicine was a Boston-based, clinical-stage biotechnology company developing epigenetic editors — CRISPR-derived medicines that silence or activate genes by writing epigenetic marks rather than cutting DNA — with CRMA-1001, a liver-targeted epigenetic editing therapy for chronic hepatitis B and hepatitis D, as its lead program. In December 2024 it merged with Nvelop Therapeutics, pairing Chroma's epigenetic editors with Nvelop's non-viral in vivo delivery vehicles, to form nChroma Bio with $75 million in new financing. chromamedicine.com now redirects to nchromabio.com. As a therapeutics developer it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Shennon Biotechnologies
providers.description: Shennon Biotechnologies is a San Francisco based biotechnology company accelerating drug development by screening millions of single cell-cell interactions to identify novel therapeutic agents for cancer and autoimmune disease. Its proprietary TCELERATOR platform combines ultrafast single cell-cell interaction mapping with proprietary AI models to discover new targets and develop more effective medicines. The company is backed by DCVC and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes a corporate marketing site but no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Astraea
providers.description: Astraea is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) clinical trial automation platform that gives pharmaceutical sponsors, biotechs, and CROs an AI operating system for clinical development. Founded by Joshua Wang and Sanmay Sarada, the platform orchestrates specialized AI agents across the full biometrics lifecycle - standards mapping, data normalization, CDISC mapping, SDTM and ADaM dataset generation, TFLs/TLFs, SAP, eCRFs, Define-XML, QC, and submission documents - turning a protocol and raw study data into FDA-submission-ready output. Astraea is positioned as sponsor-run software rather than a CRO: it runs inside the customer's own secure environment so clinical data never reaches Astraea's servers, with 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and audit-ready, standards-native traceability. The company reports serving 10+ global pharma and biotech sponsors with 30-50% faster reporting cycles.

providers.name: 858 Therapeutics
providers.description: 858 Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in San Diego, California, developing first-in-class and best-in-class small-molecule therapies that target tumor dependencies in DNA damage response (DDR) pathways. Its lead program, ETX-19477, is an oral, potent, and selective PARG (poly(ADP-ribose) glycohydrolase) inhibitor being evaluated in a Phase 1/2 study for patients with advanced solid tumors, exploiting cancer-cell vulnerabilities tied to replication stress and defects in replication-fork protection. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a clinical-stage therapeutics company it publishes a corporate and scientific web presence but no public developer, API, or documentation surface, so API artifacts are not applicable.

providers.name: Arrakis
providers.description: Arrakis Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company pioneering RNA-targeted small molecules (rSMs) as a new class of genetic medicines. Its rSM platform enables orally available small molecules to bind RNA and modulate previously undruggable biological pathways, with an industrialized discovery toolkit spanning multiple modalities. The lead proprietary program targets Type 1 Myotonic Dystrophy (DM1) at the root cause of the disease, alongside a pipeline of proprietary and partnered programs. A GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company in the life-sciences sector, Arrakis was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes a corporate and scientific website but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Arrakis Therapeutics
providers.description: Arrakis Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering RNA-targeted small molecules (rSMs) — orally available small-molecule medicines designed to bind directly to RNA and reach targets long considered undruggable. Its rSM Platform and rSM Toolkit industrialize the discovery and development of these medicines across proprietary and partnered programs, with a lead candidate addressing the root cause of Type 1 Myotonic Dystrophy (DM1). Based in Waltham, Massachusetts, the company is backed by Canaan Partners. This profile is part of the API Evangelist network; Arrakis Therapeutics does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Aspen Neuroscience
providers.description: Aspen Neuroscience is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing personalized regenerative cell therapies for Parkinson's disease. Its lead candidate, ANPD001, is an autologous induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived neuron replacement therapy that uses a patient's own cells to restore dopamine function without requiring immunosuppression, with manufacturing designed for scalable, reproducible production. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. It operates a corporate website only and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface at this time; artifact coverage here is limited to domain/identity signals.

providers.name: Asymchem
providers.description: Asymchem (Asymchem Laboratories (Tianjin) Co., Ltd.) is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) with more than 25 years of experience delivering integrated, cGMP-compliant services across the pharmaceutical value chain. Its single-source model spans route scouting, process research and development, scale-up, and commercial manufacturing for small molecules, peptides, oligonucleotides, chemical macromolecules, biologics, and synthetic biology, and is known for green chemistry and continuous flow chemistry. Headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina with major R&D and manufacturing operations in China, the U.S., and the U.K., Asymchem employs roughly 9,000 people and is publicly listed (002821.SZ / 6821.HK). Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network. Note: "API" in Asymchem's context refers to Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient manufacturing, not a public web/developer API — the company publishes no developer API surface.

providers.name: Athos Therapeutics
providers.description: Athos Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in Torrance, California developing precision small-molecule therapeutics for autoimmune and chronic inflammatory diseases, led by co-founder and CEO Dr. Dimitrios Iliopoulos. Its AI/ML discovery platform integrates multi-omic patient data — genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, epigenomics, metabolomics and microbiomics — collected with global hospital systems to identify novel drug and gene targets, and produced ATH-063, an AI-generated G9A methyltransferase inhibitor advancing in inflammatory bowel disease. The computational side of the business is commercialized through Chiron AI Labs (formerly AthosOmics.AI), a deliberately no-code omics analysis SaaS suite (Athos-Multi, Athos-T, Athos-P, Athos-G, Athos-PM) that is pre-launch and gated behind a demo waitlist. Athos publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Bexorg
providers.description: Bexorg, Inc. is a New Haven, Connecticut and San Francisco based digital-biology company building AI-powered drug-discovery infrastructure for central nervous system (CNS) therapies. Its BrainEx platform restores and sustains whole donated human brains to test drug candidates directly in human tissue, generating clinically predictive data on blood-brain-barrier delivery, target engagement, and brain exposure across small molecules, biologics, viral vectors, and lipid nanoparticles before human trials. Backed by Amplify Partners, Bexorg aims to reduce the high failure rate of CNS clinical trials. The company markets a scientific platform and does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Biotree
providers.description: Biotree (Shanghai Biotree Biomedical Technology, 百趣生物) is a Shanghai-based life-sciences company founded in 2012 that provides mass-spectrometry-driven metabolomics, proteomics, transcriptomics, and multi-omics products and services. It operates non-targeted and high-throughput targeted metabolomics platforms, single-cell and spatial omics, pharmaceutical protein characterization, clinical diagnostic test kits, and CDMO services, backed by a proprietary compound spectral library of 20,000+ standards, automated sample-preparation systems (Starlid), a LIMS, and the MAPS cloud analysis portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or specification is published at this time.

providers.name: Cure Genetics
providers.description: Cure Genetics (克睿基因) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2016 and based in Suzhou, Jiangsu, China, developing cell and gene therapies for solid tumors and genetic diseases. Its differentiated pipeline is built on two proprietary platforms: AIMS CAR-NKT, a cell-therapy approach engineered to improve solid-tumor infiltration and modulate the tumor microenvironment, and VELP, an AAV (adeno-associated viral) vector technology targeting the nervous system, heart, and kidneys. Lead programs include CGC729, an anti-CD70 CAR-NKT therapy in Phase I trials for renal cell carcinoma, and CGC-602, a PD-1-IL-2v bispecific molecule for cancer immunotherapy. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Advantech Capital, and Oriza Holdings. It publishes no public API, developer platform, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record surfaced from the Qiming portfolio.

providers.name: CytomX Therapeutics
providers.description: CytomX Therapeutics is a clinical-stage, oncology-focused biopharmaceutical company based in South San Francisco, California, pioneering a novel class of masked, conditionally activated biologic therapeutics built on its proprietary Probody platform. The Probody technology is engineered to remain inactive in healthy tissue and to become selectively unmasked and activated within the tumor microenvironment, with the goal of producing more potent, less toxic cancer medicines. The company's pipeline spans antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), T-cell engaging bispecific antibodies, and immunotherapies, advanced both internally and through partnerships with major pharmaceutical companies. CytomX is a publicly traded company (Nasdaq CTMX). This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; as a biopharmaceutical research organization CytomX does not publish a public developer API, so this profile carries company identity and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Inscinstech
providers.description: Inscinstech (Suzhou Inscinstech Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese life-sciences instrumentation manufacturer serving the biopharmaceutical industry. It designs and builds equipment for oligonucleotide and nucleic-acid synthesis, chromatography and protein purification, tangential-flow filtration, bioreactors and cell culture, nanomedicine (LNP) preparation, high-pressure preparative liquid chromatography, peptide synthesis, and analytical instruments (HPLC, capillary electrophoresis, pumps and valves), spanning laboratory, pilot, and production scale. It also delivers end-to-end process solutions for oligonucleotide drugs, mRNA, peptides, and recombinant proteins. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners. It is a hardware and instruments provider and publishes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: InventisBio
providers.description: InventisBio Co., Ltd. (Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market: 688382) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, China, with operations in New Jersey, United States. Built on independent R&D capabilities, InventisBio discovers and develops innovative small-molecule and targeted therapies for oncology, autoimmune, and metabolic diseases to address unmet medical needs. The company has advanced multiple drug candidates into clinical trials, including late-stage Phase III programs in non-small cell lung cancer and breast cancer, alongside earlier-stage assets targeting KRAS G12C, synthetic-lethal pathways, hyperuricemia/gout, and plaque psoriasis. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. InventisBio is a research-driven pharmaceutical company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Moonwalk Biosciences
providers.description: Moonwalk Biosciences is a preclinical biotechnology company pioneering therapeutics in adipose biology driven by deep genetic and epigenetic insights. Co-founded by Feng Zhang, Alex Aravanis, Arash Jamshidi and Justin Valley, the company developed a multiplex epigenetic engineering platform and has publicly shifted its focus toward siRNA-based obesity and cardiometabolic therapies. It is a private, research-stage drug-discovery organization backed by GV; its public surface is a corporate/marketing website covering its science, pipeline, team, careers and news, with no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable discovery documents.

providers.name: NanoMosaic
providers.description: NanoMosaic is a biotechnology company delivering ultra-sensitive multiomics powered by its NanoNeedle single-molecule detection technology, purpose-built for gene therapy analytics, neurology biomarkers, and brain health research. Its FDA/CBER AMT-designated AAV analytics platform supports high-sensitivity protein and biomarker quantification for therapeutics developers. Backed by Insight Partners, the company is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it operates a corporate web presence and publishes no public API, developer platform, or SDK.

providers.name: Nectero Therapeutics
providers.description: Nectero Therapeutics (also operating as Nectero Medical) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a novel, minimally invasive treatment to stabilize growth and prevent rupture of mid-sized abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA). Its lead investigational therapy is delivered as a single endovascular procedure intended to remodel and strengthen the aneurysm wall, offering an alternative to watchful waiting or open surgical repair. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and other life-sciences investors, and maintains a corporate marketing and news presence. It does not publish a developer program, public API, SDKs, or any machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Nueclear
providers.description: Nueclear Healthcare Limited, founded in 2011 and powered by Thyrocare, is one of India's leading cancer-diagnostics chains, operating a nationwide network of PET-CT and CT scan centres. It offers advanced whole-body, PSMA, DOPA, brain and bone PET-CT scans plus plain and contrast CT imaging for cancer diagnosis at affordable rates, with centres across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Lucknow, Nashik and Surat. Nueclear is a consumer diagnostic-imaging provider and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Orca Bio
providers.description: Orca Bio is a late-stage biotechnology company, headquartered in Menlo Park, California with a cGMP manufacturing facility in Sacramento, developing high-precision allogeneic cell therapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases. Its single-cell sorting platform separates donor blood with high purity and speed to build proprietary, precisely-defined mixtures of immune and stem cells. Orca Bio's lead program TREGZI is a precision-engineered allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy for hematological malignancies, alongside investigational programs Orca-T and Orca-Q. As a clinical/therapeutics company it does not publish a public developer or API surface; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis and enriched with verified company identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Orchestra
providers.description: Orchestra is an agentic operations platform for drug development and life sciences R&D organizations. The software helps biotech and pharmaceutical teams unify planning, automate operations, and reduce the risks that derail breakthrough science by creating centralized roadmaps across leadership, programs, and scientific groups, applying AI agents to operational automation, and delivering data-driven decision support across scenarios, planning, and CRO management. Orchestra is a portfolio company of 8vc and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a marketing and product site only and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Rubedo Life Sciences
providers.description: Rubedo Life Sciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing precision medicines that target the biological drivers of aging and age-related diseases. Its proprietary ALEMBIC drug-discovery platform identifies and validates senescent ("zombie") cells that accumulate with age and drive chronic disease, enabling the design of selective senolytic therapeutics. The company's lead candidate, RLS-1496, is a first-in-class selective GPX4 modulator that has produced positive Phase 1 dermatology results (plaque psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, skin aging) and Phase 1b/2a data in actinic keratosis. Rubedo is backed by Khosla Ventures and operates as a therapeutics company rather than a software/API provider — this profile carries no developer or API surface.

providers.name: Tessera Therapeutics
providers.description: Tessera Therapeutics is an early-stage life sciences company, founded and backed by Flagship Pioneering, pioneering Gene Writing — a new category of genetic medicine designed to write therapeutic messages into the genome to treat and potentially cure disease at its source. Its Gene Writing platform uses mobile genetic elements delivered via lipid nanoparticles to insert genes and exons, make small insertions and deletions, or change single or multiple DNA base pairs, with applications spanning sickle cell disease, in vivo CAR-T, HIV, and other monogenic, metabolic, autoimmune, and neurodegenerative diseases. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a health-tech portfolio lead; Tessera is a therapeutics developer and does not currently publish a public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Until
providers.description: Until (Until Labs) is a biotechnology company building the medical infrastructure to pause biological time. It is developing reversible cryopreservation systems for human organs, starting with organ-scale reversible cryopreservation to solve the donor-organ procurement and matching problem, and methodically scaling toward whole-body preservation. The lab translates the fundamentals of cryobiology into engineered workflows across five dimensions — perfusion, cryoprotectants, cooling, rewarming, and organ health assessment — using vitrification (glass, not ice) to prevent ice formation during preservation and safe rewarming. Founded by Laura Deming and Hunter Davis, Until has raised $100M+ to date and is backed by Founders Fund. Until is a research-and-development company with no public API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Alpha Biopharma
providers.description: Alpha Biopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, with an additional office in Beijing. The company focuses on the clinical development and commercialization of global innovative drugs across oncology and immunotherapy, spanning medical affairs, clinical operations, regulatory affairs and commercialization.
